_note: Single source of truth for job sources. evidence: doc = read in official/primary text this phase; secondary = third-party summary only; prior = from model knowledge, unverified; none = not investigated. NO source is READY: READY requires a passing live validation (scripts/acceptance) plus a terms review, and the Phase 0 sandbox could not reach any job API host.

sources.name: Lever Postings API
sources.terms: No API ToS in docs; postings are public, redistribution rights per employer unverified
sources.note: Needs a curated list of company slugs; no cross-company search; salaryRange/applyUrl available. EU host api.eu.lever.co.

sources.name: Greenhouse Job Board API
sources.terms: Official page unreachable from sandbox; redistribution unverified
sources.note: content=true for descriptions; pay data via pay_transparency on single-job endpoint.

sources.name: Ashby Public Job Posting API
sources.terms: Official page unreachable from sandbox; redistribution unverified
sources.note: includeCompensation=true; whole board in one response; only published jobs.

sources.name: Himalayas
sources.terms: not found - must read before use
sources.note: OpenAPI spec reportedly at himalayas.app/docs/openapi.json; unreadable from sandbox.

sources.name: Jobicy
sources.limits: count up to 100; rate limit not found
sources.terms: not found - must read before use
sources.note: Third-party mirrors only.

sources.name: Remotive
sources.terms: Must link back to Remotive job URL and name Remotive; must NOT re-submit jobs to third-party boards; must not use jobs to collect sign-ups/emails; jobs delayed 24h
sources.note: Sign-up restriction may conflict with an account-based app: legal review required.

sources.name: USAJOBS
sources.limits: 500 rows/page, 10,000 rows/query; request rate not confirmed
sources.terms: Not read (official site unreachable)
sources.note: Best free official candidate for the US; federal jobs only.

sources.name: Adzuna API
sources.terms: 'Jobs by Adzuna' label >=116x23px linked on every advert; salary estimates need Jobsworth label; commercial use other than publishing listings needs written consent after 14-day trial
sources.note: Country list from prior knowledge - verify. Caching terms not found.

sources.name: Reed.co.uk API
sources.terms: not found
sources.note: Terms must be read.

sources.name: France Travail - Offres d'emploi
sources.terms: Offers reusable, but contact data excluded; building candidate files for non-recruitment purposes prohibited
sources.note: Official portal unreachable from sandbox.

sources.name: Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit Jobsuche
sources.terms: No official public API or terms found; community docs say the agency offers no official API
sources.note: Do not integrate until the agency's terms/permission are confirmed. Fallback: external link.

sources.name: Job Bank Canada open data
sources.terms: Licence field not confirmed (commonly Open Government Licence - Canada)
sources.note: Monthly files; good for market stats, weak for freshness. No live API found.

sources.name: EURES
sources.terms: Data release limited to EURES Members/Partners or registered end users under originator consent (Decision 2017/1257); terms live in a non-public extranet
sources.note: EXTERNAL_ONLY until partner authorisation exists. Country list is the EURES area from prior knowledge - verify.

sources.name: NHS Jobs
sources.terms: APIs push employer vacancies out / display own listings; no public search API found
sources.note: Link out to NHS Jobs.

sources.name: Workforce Australia / JobSearch
sources.terms: data.gov.au vacancy datasets are statistics (Internet Vacancy Index), licence labels inconsistent; no listing API found
sources.note: Use for market context at most.

sources.name: SEEK (AU/NZ)
sources.terms: API built for hirers (posting, apply, profile); no job-search API found. Effectively EXTERNAL_ONLY for our use
sources.note: Kept CONDITIONAL per owner decision; do not build.

sources.name: JobStreet (SEEK group)
sources.terms: Same SEEK API terms; no job-search API found
sources.note: Kept CONDITIONAL per owner decision. Country list from prior knowledge.

sources.name: JobsDB (SEEK group)
sources.terms: Same SEEK API terms
sources.note: Kept CONDITIONAL per owner decision.

sources.name: Jooble
sources.limits: owner reports a lifetime call cap on the free plan; not confirmed in sources found
sources.terms: not found
sources.note: Never the primary source.

sources.name: Indeed
sources.terms: Public Publisher/Job Search API reported retired; remaining APIs are employer/partner-side and do not return search results
sources.note: Search deep-link only, per-country domains.

sources.name: ZipRecruiter
sources.terms: No self-service search API
sources.note: Link out.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.terms: Scraping prohibited; no open search API
sources.note: Search deep-link only.

sources.name: ESCO classification API (not a job source)
sources.terms: Software EUPL 1.2; DATA licence not confirmed - check before bundling
sources.note: Used for occupation mapping only.
